# Attackers from Space Event: Rewards 2026 including carnival masks

![Attackers from Space Event: Rewards 2026 including Carnival Masks](/uploads/13_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Current dates:**

![](https://nukaknights.com/uploads/event_6260987344018939_76-screenshots-invaders-0619-07.jpg) Starting in 6 days 7 hours

##### Event: Attacker from space

*Tip: Like this event to receive a notification when it starts or someone comments.*

### New information: Luminous carnival masks

From September 20th - September 21st, 2025 at 6 p.m. Rare carnival masks from General Zeta can drop at the event. This was just officially announced by Bethesda. (Source: X)

The event “Attackers from Space” or “Invaders from Beyond” is a public event and, like every seasonal event (e.g. Carnival, Meat Week, Mothman Equinox...) **always takes place on the hour**. In addition, the aliens also appear in a few other places in the game during the Alien season. More on this below.

This time there is no fixed location. The aliens can attack us in the following locations:

-Charleston Capitol Building
- Wavy Willards water park
- Dyer Chemical
- Garrahan Mining Headquarters
-Monongah
- Barren sundew grove

At the bottom of this post you will find maps with all the locations

## PROCESS

During the event you will receive your instructions from Homer Saperstein. As with daily operations, you will receive information about the next station via radio.

There are different types of enemies: Aliens, Alien Invaders and Alien Drones.

Every hour on the hour a UFO hovers over one of the respective locations.

The process takes place as follows:

- Examine the alien device
- Fight off the aliens and Major Moon
- Destroy the 3 alien research devices and defeat Colonel Cosmic
- Head to the center of the invasion
- Defeat **General Zeta** (Legendary**4 stars**)
 - Can drop all 4 star mods (except "The Adventurer")
- **Party Crasher:** After the event ends, there is a 33% chance that 4* Bigfoot will spawn

### Rare carnival masks from General Zeta

At the last carnival event there were already new masks and the lists were reorganized so that only the glowing masks are really rare. Now there is another change here. **General Zeta**, the boss alien from the **Event "Attackers from Space"** now also has the **5% chance of dropping rare carnival masks**. However, in addition to the 5% chance, there is also another variable that is currently set to 0. We'll see whether it will be activated on the server side and whether General Zeta will now drop rare carnival masks.

**Update (01/21/2025):** The drop chance was overwritten on the server side by well over 5%. We are currently observing 100% drop chance from General Zeta. The masks were dropped from September 29th, 2025 6 p.m. to September 21st, 2025 6 p.m.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-patch62-fasnacht-general-zeta.png) 

## MORE ALIEN RANDOM ENCOUNTERS

During the season of the "Attackers from Space" event, you will meet the aliens not only at the event, but also as random encounters around the world and at the following events:

- Free range
- Against the sound barrier
- Stories around the campfire
